segments.title: Cold Open & Pepito Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the station ID as a dog; Case Blackwell opens the broadcast amid breaking Iran/Israel ceasefire confusion.

segments.title: Iran/Israel Ceasefire Breaking News
segments.notes: Case and Rick parse Trump's Truth Social ceasefire announcement; conflicting reports from Iran and Israel; Rick attempts a surreal Deep State negotiation bit.

segments.title: Trailer Thursday
segments.notes: Case and Rick watch and rate trailers for Weapons, Ice Road Vengeance, Nobu documentary, Sandman Season 2, and Train Wreck Balloon Boy.

segments.title: Expert Summoning: Red Queen & Voodoo Resurrection
segments.notes: Case summons the Red Queen (Eddie) three times, then a voodoo expert to discuss resurrecting Crum; Eddie cycles through multiple personas.

segments.title: Coke vs. Pepsi Debate with Coach McGopp
segments.notes: Munch and Crum debate soda allegiance; Crum's personal trainer Coach McGopp attempts physical rehabilitation; channel-point chaos ensues.

segments.title: Amongst the Web: Kim Ketrol, Squirrels, Eric Adams
segments.notes: Case, Rick, and Eddie review viral clips: Kim Ketrol poetry recital, taxidermy(?) squirrels, Eric Adams water PSA, NYC mayoral race chat.

segments.title: Conspiracy Time: Multiverse of Crumbs & CERN
segments.notes: Case falls down a YouTube rabbit hole on the Mandela Effect, CERN, and 'world's smartest kid' Max Laughlin; ends with Baby Gronk tangent.

segments.title: News Wire Catch-Up & Ceasefire Updates
segments.notes: Case reads Reuters/BBC/HuffPost on the ceasefire; Mahmoud Khalil release; YouTube Veo3 AI slop button; alcohol-free beer sugar; Bezos wedding protests; Martin Kove assault; penis implant news; 28 Years Later zombie prosthetic; Palantir orb naming.

segments.title: Trip Bradstein: Street Opinions & Emergency Alert
segments.notes: Trip interviews park denizens amid a fake Twitch emergency alert; parade of Crum variants, zombie Crum, baby-eyebrow dimension Crum, tech support scammer, and Hushy Squirts.

segments.title: Wrap-Up & Raid
segments.notes: Case thanks viewers, mentions Wednesday return, Kendall's computer repair dilemma, and raids a Minecraft streamer (Christine).

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: lead anchor. Anchored breaking ceasefire coverage, hosted Trailer Thursday, summoned experts, moderated Munch & Crum, and fell down a CERN multiverse rabbit hole.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered cold-open as a dog; remained non-verbal for the broadcast; managed segment alerts and sub-goal updates.

characters.name: Rick
characters.role: Deep State correspondent / Amongst the Web host
characters.notes: Deep State correspondent / Amongst the Web host. Co-hosted ceasefire analysis, attempted a surreal snack-war negotiation, and joined Amongst the Web video reviews.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Walked through the studio to hype Case; later discussed her computer repair dilemma off-camera.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Debated Crum on Coke vs. Pepsi; tormented Crum over gambling losses; referenced the gorilla incident.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Struggled through Coke/Pepsi debate while Coach McGopp attempted rehab; zombie and multiverse variants appeared later.

characters.name: Coach McGopp
characters.notes: Crum's personal trainer. Joined Munch & Crum to physically rehabilitate Crum; claimed to have removed a rat from Crum's head.

characters.name: Eddie
characters.notes: call-in guest / expert. Cycled through Red Queen, voodoo resurrectionist, and multiple Crum-dimension personas during expert and street segments.

characters.name: Trip Bradstein
characters.notes: field correspondent. Conducted street interviews from the bushes amid a fake emergency alert; wrangled Crum variants and a tech-support scammer.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Interjected as 'Jeff' during news wire and conspiracy segments; bantered about AI slop and multiverse theory.

storylines.beat: [01:10:16] Munch references the gorilla medal of freedom and Crum's pending pneumatic fist execution; Coach McGopp claims Crum's head rat removed.
[08:39] Trump announces ceasefire via Truth Social; [02:38:21] Reuters reports conflicting missile launches and denials; ceasefire status unresolved at sign-off.

lore_notes.fact: [41:05] Voice deepening described as 'next level puberty' despite being past his 20s.
[01:12:45] Coach McGopp claims to have removed 'most of the rat' from Crum's head.
[11:04] Non-verbal for the entire broadcast; Case notes 'he's non-verbal today.'
[03:11:42] Computer repair dilemma: $150/hr in-house service needed; Case plans to take it in while she's at the office.
[02:52:28] Keeps a computer in his bush; claims to be landlord of the bush he claimed.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell anchors a chaotic Monday broadcast dominated by a confusing Trump-announced Iran/Israel ceasefire that may or may not hold. The show cycles through Trailer Thursday, a multiverse-themed expert block summoning the Red Queen and a voodoo resurrectionist, a Coke vs. Pepsi Munch & Crum debate derailed by Crum's trainer Coach McGopp, an Amongst the Web viral review, a deep-dive into CERN Mandela Effect conspiracy theory, and a Trip on the Street segment interrupted by a fake Twitch emergency alert and a parade of interdimensional Crum variants. The ceasefire remains unverified as the stream ends with a raid.
